concerns.text: The plan describes MDES calculation and robustness checks but never explicitly references the `PowerAnalysisResult` entity defined in `data-model.md` nor the `mdes_report.schema.yaml` contract. Adding a step that writes the MDES output to `data/processed/power_analysis.csv` (or similar) and cites the corresponding schema will close the Plan ↔ Data‑Model and Plan ↔ Contracts consistency gap.
